facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/int.run_interactive_reader: run the DrQA reader model interactively with a pretrained model and GPU support
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/int.process_document_question: process a document and question to extract answer spans with ranked scores
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/int.run_reader_with_tokenizer: run the DrQA reader with a specified tokenizer like corenlp for tokenization

facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/pre.process_dataset: process a SQuAD dataset with multiprocessing to tokenize questions and contexts with lemma, POS, and NER annotations
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/pre.find_answer: find the start and end token indices matching character offsets for an answer span in a document

facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/tra.run_drqa_reader_training: run the DrQA reader training script to train a document reading comprehension model on SQuAD data
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/tra.add_train_args_parser: add commandline arguments for training a DrQA model including GPU, batch size, and embedding options
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/tra.init_from_scratch_model: initialize a new DocReader model from scratch with a word dictionary and pretrained embeddings
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/tra.validate_official_squad: validate the DrQA model using official SQuAD exact match and F1 score evaluation metrics
facebookresearch_drqa/scripts/reader/tra.set_defaults_args: set default values and validate file paths for DrQA training commandline arguments
